infos.title: Dell XPS 13 (2026) Business Laptop
infos.desc: 13-inch business ultrabook, 1.2kg, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, aimed at road-warrior professionals who need a light, all-day-battery laptop.

reviews.text: At 1.2kg it barely adds any weight to my bag, and the battery genuinely lasts a full workday.
